capabilities: Search Google Drive and insert file links into notes
Upload dropped or pasted files to Drive with content-hash dedup
Preview images, videos, and PDFs from Drive links inside notes
Browse, rename, move, star, and delete Drive files from a sidebar
Migrate existing vault attachments to Drive and rewrite links after preview
extras: Setup requires creating a personal Google Cloud project and OAuth client (10–15 minutes one-time). Desktop only; sign-in not available on phones. Beta builds available via BRAT. Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Large attachments accumulate in the vault, making it slow to sync and heavy to back up, while the files themselves are rarely opened.

relations.evidence: Inspired by and building on the ideas of Google Drive Folder Link by Andrew Marconi.
relations.plugin: Google Drive Folder Link by Andrew Marconi

summary: Google Drive integration that uploads dropped, pasted, or searched files to Drive, inserts durable Drive-link notes, and manages Drive files from a sidebar.
